import fitz

doc = fitz.open(r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\New folder (2)\Non-traumatic orthopedics midterm.pdf")

for page_num in range(5, 10):

    for block in dict_out['blocks']:
        if block['type'] == 0: # text block
            for line in block['lines']:
                line_text = ""
                for span in line['spans']:
                    text = span['text']
                    
                    # Convert bullet point
                    text = text.replace('•', '-')
                    
                    # Check for bold font
                    if 'Bold' in span['font'] or span['flags'] & 16:
                        text = f"**{text}**"
                    
                    line_text += text
                md_text += line_text + "\n"

with open(r"C:\Users\renu5\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\part2.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
